title: Let a task name a question id as its blocker, clearing when the question resolves (seq 179d)
description:
opum-doc seq 179, item (d), relayed by opum-agent. Design: opum-doc docs/reference/operator-questions-in-quest-design.md at main.

A task can be blocked by a question: it names the question id, and the block clears when that question resolves rather than needing a second write. Today a task's blocked reason is unrecorded and unverifiable -- QCLI-251 records that the blockers field has no CLI write path at all -- so the first thing this task does is establish what the field ACTUALLY supports, and report that, rather than assuming it can carry a reference.

If the field cannot express a reference as it stands, that is a finding to report to opum-doc, not a design call to make locally.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A task can name a question id as its blocker through the CLI, and the block clears when that question resolves
What the blockers field supports today is MEASURED and reported, including whether it can carry a reference at all, before the shape is built on
A task blocked by an unresolved question is excluded from ready work, and returns when it resolves
